gauss_l_definition.exact_elimination_reason: entire nodal P1 hat support lies in w=1, so (1-w)*hat is identically zero

gauss_l_definition.weight: same S5 coast-window function as the declared frozen reference

positive_trace_definition.exact_tail_bypass: At s=cut take E=E_xi=all E parameter/state partials=0 along the accurate analytic nonnegative tail family
positive_trace_definition.exact_trace_gauge: At entire-hat plateau nodes set raw n correction=(old n-old l)/2, raw l correction=negative of it; d unchanged
positive_trace_definition.invariant_fields: d=n-l and m from the actual R153 background
positive_trace_definition.positive_K_domain: K>=0 at active non-cut points; h>0 when its general derivative is used; no n floor added
positive_trace_definition.tail_contract: All correction coefficients at cut are exactly zero; existing positive tail parameters define the complete true trace
positive_trace_definition.weight: S5((s-start)/(ramp_stop-start)), clipped, then exactly one up to cut
